Yash Mishra
Backend Engineer | Remote (India)
yash.mishra977@example.com | +91 9160883265

Results-oriented backend engineer with a strong focus on building scalable microservices and reliable APIs. Experienced delivering production services in cloud environments, optimizing background processing, and collaborating in Agile teams to ship features rapidly. Seeking opportunities to apply backend and cloud expertise to high-impact systems. Notice period: 15 days.

Experience

Accenture — Sep 2025 - Present
Backend Engineer | Remote
- Implemented AWS-hosted microservices and containerized components using Docker, reducing service startup time by 35% and lowering infra cost per deployment by 18%.
- Designed and launched Celery-based background processing pipelines for asynchronous tasks, increasing throughput to 6k tasks/hour and reducing request latency for user-facing endpoints by 40%.
- Integrated Redis as a caching and rate-limiting layer, cutting repeated DB reads by 70% and improving API response consistency across 12 endpoints.
- Automated CI/CD deployments to AWS with scripted Docker image promotion, achieving a mean time to deploy of under 20 minutes while preserving zero-downtime releases.

NimbusSoft — May 2023 - Aug 2025
Software Engineer - Backend | Remote
- Built REST APIs with FastAPI and Django for a payments and reconciliation platform, handling peak loads of 800 RPS and maintaining P95 latency under 220ms.
- Architected Microservices split for billing, notifications, and reconciliation, enabling independent scaling and decreasing incident blast radius; improved deployment frequency by 2.5x.
- Containerized services with Docker and coordinated inter-service caching via Redis, which decreased database load by 60% and reduced operational costs.
- Implemented observability for background jobs using Celery metrics and dashboards, leading to a 45% reduction in failed job recovery time.

Vertex Analytics — Mar 2020 - Apr 2023
Angular Developer | Remote
- Developed responsive dashboards and data visualizations using Angular and TypeScript, increasing customer engagement time by 32%.
- Collaborated with backend teams to consume REST APIs efficiently, implementing client-side caching and optimistic UI patterns that improved perceived performance by 25%.
- Drove component library improvements and performance tuning that reduced bundle sizes by 28% and initial load times across core pages.
- Actively contributed to Agile ceremonies and maintained technical documentation in Confluence to streamline onboarding and cross-team knowledge sharing.

Projects
- Async Task Monitor: Internal tool that aggregates Celery task metrics and Redis state to surface failing jobs and SLA breaches; reduced manual incident triage time by 50%.
- Lightweight API Gateway: Prototype gateway using FastAPI for routing and rate limiting with Redis, validated at 2k RPS in load tests.

Languages: Python 3, TypeScript
Frameworks / Backend: Django, FastAPI, REST APIs, Celery
Infrastructure: AWS, Docker, Redis, Microservices
Other: Angular, Confluence, Agile

B.Tech, Computer Science, VIT Vellore
